scope: Slice 5 protection transition only; research prototype

behaviors: Plan is read-only and rejects server-generated keys, unsupported types, missing tenancy, and reviewed small search domains.
Native committed rows, text types, exact Unicode, empty text and SQL NULL survive protection; sync and async attached CRUD resumes.
Writes committed before fencing are included; concurrent runtime writes during backfill fail explicitly and can be retried after publication.
Runtime can inspect progress but cannot mutate the journal, disable the fence, change schema or acquire ownership.
Independent processes killed at durable phases and during a partial chunk resume without lost rows or replacement of committed ciphertext.
A real protocol proxy discards a terminal COMMIT reply; independently inspected chunk state determines resume.
Real connection failures during expand, verification and switch leave no false completion or partially switched DDL.
Independent HKDF/HMAC/AEAD decoding compares migrated frames with every original native value.
Full verification rejects missing rows, NULL substitution, altered tags/source/generations/indexes/fences and additional triggers.
Valid retained-generation ciphertext cannot satisfy the current active generation requirement.
Switch repeats full verification and retains table locks against a late privileged writer.
Restored older own-schema pg_dump snapshots cannot override the outside-database current pin; stale authority cannot change representation.
Unpublished, stale or wrong target/operation/digest pins, changed key policies and owner-role attachment refuse admission.
Chunk marker failure rolls back actual data changes; competing cooperating executors refuse.
Pre-switch abort restores native data and writes, is idempotent, and refuses cutover rollback.

review: Focused AI static review; no independent human review. Three reported admission defects fixed and regression-proved.
failure_history: Initial missing product API was observed before implementation.
Owner-lock test harness used a second read connection and deadlocked; use of the lock-owning connection fixed it.
A quoted relation name was missing in the scoped PgSleep test observation; the augmented suite had 1 failure and 916 passes before correction. Final fresh suite has 917 passes.
The independent retained-generation decoder initially used a generation-one salt; correcting it to the published context-generation composition established the valid-generation-two oracle.
The original fixed WAL multiplier underestimated million-row cluster WAL; planner now requires explicit host storage/WAL observations. Final performance receipt binds the corrected source.
limits: Outside pin and writer inventory are host assertions, not authenticated deployment enforcement.
Schema-only logical restore of an owned test schema is not production cluster restore/failover qualification.
Raw/owner/DDL writers and restored permissions require host exclusion/quarantine; attachment is not a cryptographic database write gate.
No current-row freshness, hostile completeness, authenticated SQL NULL or plaintext erasure guarantee.
One protect operation per schema; no new tenant policy admission, decrypt-back, removal or rotation implemented.
Real capacity exhaustion, production pause budget, provider custody and retained encrypted backup recovery remain unverified.
